name: ValorBrain
description: Hosted team memory for OpenClaw: recall before every turn, optional transcript capture, memory tools. HTTP only.

apiUrl.label: ValorBrain API URL
apiUrl.help: REST base of the engine. Default: the hosted API. Point it at your own engine if you run one.

token.label: ValorBrain token
token.help: Personal token (vbm_). Leave empty to read VALORBRAIN_API_TOKEN from the gateway's environment.

recall.label: Recall before every turn
recall.help: Sends the cleaned, redacted user message to ValorBrain and injects the memory it returns (default on).

captureTranscript.label: Send conversation for extraction
captureTranscript.help: Uploads the cleaned, redacted conversation so ValorBrain extracts decisions and episodes (default off). Also needs hooks.allowConversationAccess.

tools.label: Memory tools
tools.help: Registers valorbrain_search, valorbrain_get and valorbrain_store (default on).
